title: Shipment ETA without reaching through the carrier
task: Add a `Shipment` to package `dispatch` that is handed to a `Carrier` and can report its estimated arrival: the carrier's first departure after the shipment's ready time, plus the carrier's transit time. If there is no such departure the caller gets an error. Read the existing file and give the collaborators the methods they need rather than pulling their internals out through accessor chains. Test an ETA and the no-departure case.
